title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações em Java;

  • Contribuir com boas práticas de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código;
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de sistemas, APIs e microserviços;
  • Integrar sistemas, mensageria e serviços em cloud;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambientes ágeis.

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Java (versões mais recentes são um diferencial);

title: Salesforce Business System Analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)

Location: LATAM

Duration: 6-12months

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.

Key Responsibilities:

·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.

·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows .

·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.

·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards .

·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.

·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.

·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation .

·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.

·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams .

·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization .

Required Qualifications:

·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure .

·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud .

·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management .

·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies .

·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications .

·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration .

·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration .

·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Representante de negócios
description:
️ Procuro Representantes Comerciais para Projeto Imobiliário em Balneário Camboriú

Se você tem uma rede de contatos com empresários, médicos, agropecuaristas ou investidores com capital para alocar — quero conversar com você.

Estamos com alguns empreendimentos premium em Camboriú, VGV que ultrapassam 9 dígitos, com rentabilidade atrativa para o investidor e preciso de parceiros comerciais para apresentar oportunidades privadas de participação financeira a investidores qualificados.

O modelo:  → 100% comissão sobre o resultado → Sem metas, sem horário, sem hierarquia → Você apresenta. Fechou = você recebe → Ticket mínimo por operação: a partir de R$ 100.000 → Comissão: até 3% sobre o valor captado

Ganhos a partir de R$ 3.000 para você.

Não precisa de experiência em finanças. Precisa ter relacionamento com pessoas investidoras.

Se você é corretor de alto padrão, assessor, empresário com rede sólida ou simplesmente conhece as pessoas certas — me chama no privado.

Envie mensagem com \"CAMBORIÚ\" para eu te passar os detalhes.

Vagas limitadas — trabalho com poucos parceiros, mas os certos.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

description:
Responsável pelo monitoramento e análise geral da pontualidade, incluindo análise de duração e monitoramento da taxa de cumprimento;

Monitoramento de problemas anormais de pontualidade, incluindo, entre outros:

Monitoramento e melhoria de itens fora do prazo (SLA);

Acompanhamento de problemas não resolvidos; Monitoramento e promoção da correção de interrupções de atualização;

Necessario:Dominío do Excel, atenção aos dados e experiência em logística (preferencial); habilidade no uso de diversos softwares de escritório; disponibilidade para viagens e horas extras.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Account Manager Pleno
description:
A Argo Solutions é uma empresa de tecnologia SaaS, referência em soluções para gestão de viagens corporativas, despesas e pagamentos. Com presença em 18 países, mais de 4.700 clientes e 1 milhão de usuários, vivemos um momento de evolução, com foco em escalabilidade, excelência na experiência do cliente e maturidade dos nossos processos.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Account Manager (Corporate / Enterprise) com forte atuação estratégica, experiência no atendimento a grandes contas e vivência, preferencialmente, no segmento de viagens corporativas (TMCs, travel techs ou gestão de despesas).


Essa pessoa será responsável por gerir relacionamentos de alto nível, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração contínua de valor, com forte interface com gestores de viagens (Travel Managers), áreas de compras, financeiro e stakeholders executivos.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira de clientes corporativos (mid-market e enterprise);
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o negócio do cliente e propondo soluções estratégicas;
  • Construir relacionamento com stakeholders de diferentes níveis, incluindo C-level;
  • Atuar diretamente com clientes na gestão de viagens corporativas, despesas e políticas de mobilidade;
  • Identificar e conduzir oportunidades de upsell, cross-sell e expansão de contratos;
  • Liderar reuniões executivas (QBRs, comitês, apresentações estratégicas);
  • Acompanhar indicadores de sucesso, adoção e engajamento da solução;
  • Antecipar riscos, atuar na retenção e estruturar planos de ação;
  • Ser o elo entre cliente e áreas internas (Produto, Suporte, Financeiro, Tech);
  • Contribuir com insights de mercado e melhorias contínuas na jornada do cliente.


Competências técnicas necessárias:

  • Experiência sólida como Account Manager, Customer Success Manager ou áreas correlatas, com foco em grandes contas;
  • Vivência no atendimento a clientes enterprise e ambientes corporativos complexos;
  • Forte capacidade de negociação e gestão de contratos;
  • Perfil consultivo, analítico e orientado a resultados;

Graduação completa em Administração, Marketing, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.

CLT | Híbrido (2x por semana presencial)

  • Parcerias com universidades, idiomas e restaurantes;

  • Auxílio creche.


Se você tem experiência no universo de viagens corporativas e gosta de atuar de forma estratégica com grandes contas, essa é a oportunidade!

title: Analista de Manufatura
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Se você é um(a) profissional Analista de Manufatura em busca de uma oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, esta posição oferece a chance de contribuir diretamente para a eficiência, segurança e padronização dos processos de montagem. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar as operações de montagem de válvulas, garantindo execução padronizada, segura e eficiente, seguindo os conceitos de Lean Manufacturing e Engenharia de Processos. Também atuará na melhoria contínua, redução de desperdícios e estabilidade dos processos produtivos, assegurando conformidade com requisitos de qualidade e prazos de entrega.


Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Foco na operação de montagem: Otimizar e padronizar atividades de montagem de válvulas criando instruções de trabalho e roteiros de produção com base em desenhos, padrões de processo e especificações do produto.
  • Aplicação de Lean Manufacturing: Atuar na identificação e eliminação de desperdícios nos processos de montagem, apoiar setor de produção na aplicação das ferramentas Lean (5S no posto de trabalho, Padronização de processo, Kaizen e sugestões de melhoria, Poka-Yoke, Fluxo contínuo e balanceamento básico de operações.
  • Documentação e Sistemas:
  • Apoiar a implementação de novos processos, validações, estudos de tempo e melhorias de layout, quando necessário.
  • Contribuir com feedback técnico sobre ferramentas, dispositivos e instruções de montagem.
  • Auxiliar na execução de testes funcionais e inspeções de qualidade conforme instruções definidas.
  • Reportar desvios de processo, defeitos ou anomalias utilizando ferramentas como Ishikawa, 5 Porquês ou formulários de não conformidade.
  • Segurança, Ambiente e Organização: Cumprir rigidamente normas de Segurança do Trabalho, instruções de EPI e procedimentos de manuseio de componentes. Reportar condições inseguras ou potenciais riscos imediatamente, bem como apoiar soluções na mitigação de riscos.

Quem você é:

Você aprende rapidamente e utiliza novas informações para aprimorar processos e resolver desafios de maneira prática. Trabalha de forma colaborativa, construindo relações positivas e comunicando-se de forma clara com diferentes equipes. Demonstra atenção consistente aos detalhes e mantém alta qualidade em suas entregas, mesmo diante de múltiplas demandas. Busca melhorias contínuas e contribui ativamente com ideias que elevam a eficiência, reduzem falhas e aumentam a confiabilidade operacional.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Técnico em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Produção Industrial (desejável Engenharia Mecânica ou de Produção)
  • Experiência em ambiente fabril e montagem mecânica (preferencialmente em produtos de engenharia como válvulas ou equipamentos de processo)
  • Conhecimentos em Lean Manufacturing e melhoria contínua
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e instruções de montagem
  • Experiencia na utilização de ferramentas manuais, pneumáticas e instrumentos de medição simples
  • Noções de Engenharia de Processos (fluxo de processos, tempo padrão, inspeção visual, segurança)
  • Familiaridade com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Engenharia Mecânica ou de Produção
  • Cursos técnicos no SENAI voltados a indústria
  • Conhecimentos técnicos em hidráulica e pneumática
  • Leitura e interpretação de documentos em inglês

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Engenheiro de Comissionamento de Subestações
description:
A Quadrante


Ao fazer parte do Grupo você terá a oportunidade de integrar um time jovem, dinâmico e ambicioso. Somos mais de 1000 profissionais empenhados no desenvolvimento das melhores soluções para o cliente e apostamos no crescimento profissional das nossas equipes, através da participação em projetos desafiantes.


O espírito de colaboração está presente no nosso DNA, tanto através da partilha de conhecimentos no dia-a-dia, quanto através de iniciativas que reforçam a comunidade. Acreditamos no potencial de cada um e queremos ajudá-lo a desenvolver as suas capacidades.


Principais Responsabilidades


·Executar atividades de comissionamento de subestações MT/AT;

Realizar testes em:

  • Transformadores de potência e distribuição;
  • Painéis de proteção, controle e serviços auxiliares;
  • Relés de proteção (ANSI / IEC);
  • Sistemas de CC (baterias e carregadores);
  • Sistemas de aterramento;

Executar testes de :

  • Relação de transformação, resistência de enrolamento, isolamento;
  • Injeção secundária e primária;
  • Lógicas de proteção, intertravamentos e permissivos;

· Atuar na energização e start-up da subestação;

· Elaborar e revisar procedimentos, checklists e relatórios de comissionamento;

· Interface técnica com cliente, EPC, fabricantes e equipes de obra;

· Gestão de pendências (punch list) e apoio à liberação final do sistema.


Requisitos


· Formação em Engenharia Elétrica;

· Experiência comprovada em comissionamento de subestações;

Conhecimento em :

  • Diagramas unifilares, trifilares e funcionais;
  • Filosofia de proteção e seletividade;
  • Normas ABNT, IEC, IEEE, ONS/ANEEL (quando aplicável);

· Disponibilidade para trabalho em campo e viagens;

· Compromisso com segurança operacional (NR-10, SEP).


Diferenciais


· Experiência em subestações 69 kV e 138 kV;

· Vivência com relés SEL, Siemens, ABB, Schneider, GE;

· Experiência com SCADA, telecom e integração de sistemas;

· Inglês técnico.

title: HR Operations Senior Specialist
description:
About Us

Keeta is a technology-driven delivery platform that connects consumers with local food and retail merchants and couriers. Operating as an independent brand under Meituan, one of the world’s largest tech-driven retail companies, we are driven by the mission: \"Help People Eat Better, Live Better.\"

Since its founding in March 2010, Meituan has revolutionized the digital landscape, reshaping supply and demand dynamics across service and product retail through rapid growth and innovation. Keeta builds on this industry influence, bringing exceptional capabilities, swift responsiveness, and quality service to elevate the delivery sector and enhance the lives of users worldwide.

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into new markets including Brazil, Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail.

We combine Meituan’s global expertise with local innovation to deliver exceptional, customer-centric services and seamless experiences. Join Keeta as we take this success story into new markets, driving innovation, growth, and excellence.


What You'll Do

We seek an experienced HR Operations Senior Specialist to drive HR policy development, SOP creation, process optimization, and team enablement. This role ensures standardized, well-implemented HR policies and processes support business goals and compliance.

HR Policy Enablement & Governance:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.
  • Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.

HR Process Standardization & Optimization:

  • Design, document, and continuously improve HR processes to enhance efficiency and compliance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are well-integrated and operationally sound.
  • Establish clear workflows and guidelines for employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, probation and internal mobility, etc..

Quality Controal & Employee Experience

  • Ensure seamless execution of HR policies to improve employee experience and operational efficiency.
  • Provide training and communication on policy updates and process changes to HR teams and managers.
  • Conduct periodic audits to verify adherence to HR policies and recommend corrective actions where needed.
  • Implement a quality audit framework to regularly assess HR operations, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Assistente de contabilidade
description:
A Braspress é uma das maiores transportadoras do país, referência em logística e inovação no setor de transporte de encomendas. Com foco em excelência operacional e desenvolvimento de pessoas, buscamos profissionais comprometidos, organizados e com visão de crescimento para integrar nossa equipe.


Descrição da vaga

O profissional será responsável por executar atividades contábeis, garantindo a precisão das informações financeiras, o cumprimento das obrigações legais e o suporte às rotinas administrativas e de fechamento contábil.


Responsabilidades

  • Conciliar contas do ativo, passivo, receitas e despesas, realizando os ajustes necessários;
  • Solicitar e acompanhar a cobrança de documentos que respaldem as informações contábeis;
  • Controlar, calcular, classificar e lançar apropriações mensais de despesas registradas em contas do exercício seguinte;
  • Realizar o controle e a conciliação das posições financeiras da empresa, incluindo financiamentos, leasing e empréstimos;
  • Analisar e conciliar dados da folha de pagamento;
  • Realizar levantamento e organização de documentação;
  • Executar e acompanhar a renovação de certificações e certidões;
  • Apoiar o fechamento contábil das empresas do grupo;
  • Apoiar e executar a entrega das obrigações acessórias;
  • Conferir a movimentação financeira;
  • Prestar suporte durante auditorias internas e externas;
  • Efetuar a conciliação das apurações de impostos (IRPJ, CSLL, IOF, PIS, COFINS e ICMS).


Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Desejável experiência prévia em rotinas contábeis e financeiras;


Informações adicionais

  • Horário: Comercial
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products

  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar

  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Gerente Garantia Qualidade IFA
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte de uma das maiores indústrias farmacêuticas da América Latina?

A Blau é uma indústria farmacêutica líder no segmento hospitalar e pioneira em biotecnologia, com portfólio proprietário de medicamentos de alta complexidade, com foco em segmentos relevantes da indústria, como imunologia, hematologia, oncologia, especialidades e antibióticos em diversas classes, entre outros.

A Blau possui footprint continental, estando presente em seis países da América Latina e nos Estados Unidos. Conta com um moderno complexo industrial farmacêutico, composto por cinco plantas industriais com tecnologia de ponta, dedicadas à produção de medicamentos biológicos, biotecnológicos, oncológicos, antibióticos, anestésicos injetáveis e insumos biotecnológicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Responsável pelo GMP da planta de IFA recombinante, assegurando integridade de dados, controle de processos biotecnológicos e prontidão para inspeções nacionais e internacionais, por meio da conformidade regulatória, robustez do SGQ e dos documentos de validação (processo e limpeza).
  • Liderar os times de SGQ e Validação da planta de IFA recombinante, atuando como elo entre qualidade, desenvolvimento e produção para garantir execução consistente, compliance GMP e alinhamento entre as áreas.
  • Garantir a integração e conformidade entre Qualidade, Produção e Validação, assegurando a transferência e implementação robusta de processos e documentos do desenvolvimento para a operação.
  • Assegurar a estratégia, execução e governança dos estudos críticos de qualidade para produtos biológicos conforme expectativas regulatórias.

Necessário

  • Sólida experiência em biotecnologia, com atuação prática em produtos biológicos e IFA recombinante em ambiente GMP, incluindo forte vivência em SGQ, validação de limpeza e validação de processos.
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas e de processos produtivos e de qualidade relacionados à biotecnologia e ao desenvolvimento e produção de IFA.
  • Atuação direta, com responsabilidade técnica, na garantia da conformidade de processos e documentação ao longo da transição do desenvolvimento para a produção, incluindo tomada de decisão relacionada ao SGQ e à estratégia de estudos.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de Sistemas de Gestão da Qualidade, incluindo tratamento de desvios, CAPA e change control, integrada a atividades de validação (processos, limpeza e/ou sistemas) aplicadas a IFA recombinante.
  • Experiência na execução e na governança de estudos críticos para produtos biológicos, incluindo clearance viral, avaliação de vírus adventícios, estudos de extraíveis e lixiviáveis, gestão do ciclo de vida de resinas, estudos de estabilidade e validações de processo e de limpeza.
  • Formação superior completa com CRF ativo
  • Pós Graduação em área biotecnológica ou semelhantes
  • Inglês e ou espanhol avançado

Principais desafios do cargo

Dimensão técnico‑operacional


• Atuação em um contexto de elevada complexidade tecnológica, envolvendo processos biotecnológicos integrados de fermentação, purificação e etapas de downstream.

• Gestão da variabilidade inerente a produtos biológicos, com foco em consistência, robustez de processo e manutenção do estado validado.

• Definição e sustentação da estratégia de controle microbiológico e de contaminação, incluindo aspectos relacionados a endotoxinas e segurança do produto.

• Forte necessidade de integração e alinhamento entre as áreas de Controle de Qualidade, Produção e Validação, exigindo atuação colaborativa e visão sistêmica dos processos.

Dimensão regulatória e de inspeções


• Preparação e sustentação da organização para inspeções regulatórias internacionais, com destaque para autoridades como INVIMA e, futuramente, EMA.

• Condução das atividades de resposta a inspeções, incluindo análise de observações, definição de planos de ação e gestão de CAPAs regulatórias de forma consistente e estratégica.

Horário: Seg/Qui 07h45 - 17h e Sex até 15h30

Formato: 100% presencial

title: Bolsista Doutor - Indusbello - Estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais| Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Vem transformar com a gente!

Com sede em Londrina (PR) e presença consolidada em mais de 30 países, a Indusbello investe fortemente em pesquisa, desenvolvimento e tecnologia, consolidando-se como uma das marcas líderes em soluções para a saúde.

Seu compromisso com a qualidade, a ética e a inovação contínua norteiam sua atuação no mercado há mais de três décadas. A empresa possui certificações internacionais como ISO 9001, ISO 13485, marcação CE e aprovação de produtos pelo FDA.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Principais Atividades:

  • Planejar e desenvolver projetos de estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais;
  • Propor a internalização de processos produtivos com foco em competitividade;
  • Identificar gargalos produtivos e desenvolver soluções inovadoras ;
  • Implantar novos processos industriais com foco em eficiência e inovação.


Conhecimento necessário:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise e melhoria de processos (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Vivência em projetos de melhoria e inovação em processos industriais ;
  • Análise de viabilidade e implantação de projetos de redução de custos;
  • Experiência com internalização de processos produtivos ;
  • Projetos de digitalização e automação industrial.


Conhecimento desejável:

  • Conhecimento no ERP Protheus – Totvs.
  • Conhecimento em processos para produtos da área da saúde.
